summary: A gamelan-inspired instrument, mostly Balinese: you lead the core melody on the white keys and the ensemble's interlocking parts, gongs, drums and flute follow it, with the beating 'ombak' shimmer on every note. Made for meditative playing as well as traditional forms.
features: Nine gamelan presets and eleven measured tunings, incl. slendro, pelog, Selonding
Gong forms such as Gilak, Lancaran, Ketawang and Ladrang
Kotekan, reyong, ornaments, kendang and suling switched in or out
Tempo from 96 beats a minute down to one per 20 seconds
Loop recorder for the core; angsel breaks and a cued ending
USB and TRS MIDI in, clock follow and clock out
